character: Silvertongue (Western Heart roster/silvertongue, Slot 1 Spy Debut default attire)

entries.name: Original face texture
entries.notes: Game-original T_CH_lil_face_D (pre-007-makeup). Re-embed as T_CH_lil_face_D (material Modelpart1_face_Material006) in roster/silvertongue/attires/spy-debut/silvertongue-spy-debut.glb to restore.

entries.name: Original lip texture
entries.notes: Game-original T_CH_lil_lip_D. Re-embed as T_CH_lil_lip_D (material Modelpart1_lip_Material029).

entries.name: Original eyebrow texture
entries.notes: Game-original T_CH_lil_eyebrow_D. Re-embed as T_CH_lil_eyebrow_D (material Modelpart1_eyebrow_Material024).

entries.name: Original hair texture
entries.notes: Game-original blonde T_CH_lil_hair_1p_D. Re-embed as T_CH_lil_hair_1p_D (materials Modelpart2_hair1_Material047 / Modelpart2_hair2_Material048).

entries.name: Original drill rolls + tiara + corsage (meshes)
entries.notes: The 7 removed meshes (2 drill rolls, tiara, 4 corsage pieces) as a restorable GLB. Re-attach to the Spy Debut GLB (same coordinates, no re-rig needed — static meshes) to restore the original hair silhouette.

how_to_swap: 1. Pick an option PNG/GLB from entries above (or the eye options in customization/parts/lili-eyes/).
2. Re-embed a PNG as its replaces_texture in roster/silvertongue/attires/spy-debut/silvertongue-spy-debut.glb — full replace at the listed size.
3. Re-attach the drill-hair-tiara-corsage.glb meshes to restore the original hair silhouette (same coordinates).
4. Nothing is overwritten: the Spy Debut GLB keeps its spy look; options swap in/out Tekken/WWE-style.
